official_xp_usable: A gameweek is usable only when its maximum official_xp is greater than 0. An all-zero gameweek is an unfilled scrape, not a forecast.

encompassing.formula: total_points = a + b * score_official_xp + c * score_xp
encompassing.walk_forward: within each season, ordinary least squares on earlier usable gameweeks only
encompassing.survive_if: the 95% interval for the mean of c on 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 lies entirely above 0

decision_slice.population: eligible rows only: n_prior >= 3 and xmi >= 45
decision_slice.rank: Spearman of the score against total_points within season, gameweek and position

note: Gaussian log score with sigma fixed at 3. The bootstrap resamples gameweeks, not player rows. 2026-27 is not in the closed-season comparison. Gameweeks 1-5 of that season were already read. The clean holdout starts at gameweek 6. A season total is not a pass.
